exposure: failed vacuum delivery leading to an emergency cesarean delivery
cohort: 7978 neonates born following successful or failed vacuum vaginal delivery
finding: Failed vacuum delivery was not independently associated with long-term hematologic morbidity in offspring up to 18 years of age compared to successful vacuum delivery.
mod_finding: This study compared long-term outcomes in children born by successful vacuum delivery versus those born after failed vacuum leading to emergency cesarean.
